# Fewya

> Fewya is an open-source marketplace where shoppers buy new products from professional sellers and small businesses run their online storefronts.

Fewya has two connected products: a mobile-first shopping experience for buyers and a seller workspace for catalog, order, shipping, and storefront management. The service is an early work in progress; verify time-sensitive availability and policies on the live site.

## Product guide

- [Fewya overview](https://fewya.com/index.md): Concise, LLM-friendly product facts, capabilities, audiences, and limits.
- [Marketplace](https://fewya.com/): Browse the live marketplace and active shops.
- [Product search](https://fewya.com/search): Search the public catalog.
- [Sell on Fewya](https://fewya.com/sell): Seller proposition and onboarding entry point.

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martinezharo/fewya/main/README.md): Current architecture, integrations, setup, deployment, and public catalog feed.
